# Riverbend — Glossary / Internal Jargon

- **Boarding** — an admitted patient held in the ED because no inpatient bed is available;
  Riverbend's top throughput constraint.
- **Door-to-provider** — minutes from ED arrival to first provider contact; a core ED metric.
- **O/E LOS** — observed-to-expected length of stay; > 1.0 means patients stay longer than
  their case mix predicts.
- **Block utilization** — share of allocated OR "block" time actually used; a perioperative
  efficiency measure.
- **Capacity huddle** — the daily 09:00 system call that balances patient load across the four
  hospitals.
- **Deemed status** — Joint Commission accreditation that stands in for a direct CMS survey of
  the Conditions of Participation.
- **Plan of Correction (POC)** — the formal, deadline-bound response a hospital owes The Joint
  Commission after survey findings.
- **Command center** — the temporary Epic go-live support hub (at-the-elbow support + ticket
  triage) stood up for [Epic Phase 1](../projects/epic-golive-phase-1.md); demobilizes when
  stabilization completes.
- **The Tower** — internal shorthand for the [New Patient Tower](../projects/new-patient-tower.md)
  under construction at the flagship.
- **Lantern** — code name for a confidential initiative; use the code name only, never the
  underlying subject.
